scope: Standing Old Point Loma Lighthouse at Cabrillo National Monument, with its whitewashed dwelling, west kitchen lean-to, central tower, circular gallery, copper lantern cap, east-side entrance steps and reconstructed assistant keeper’s cottage.

originalReview.notes: Exact 2024 exterior shows the rough whitewashed masonry, dark green sash, black metal gallery and rail, turquoise copper cap, two chimneys, kitchen lean-to and nearby historic flagstaff.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact local Qualla photo byte-matches Paul Vaurie’s own 2024 Commons upload with signed CC0 in its first revision. The federal HABS section and NPS register corroborate the exterior dimensions.
